necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and underlying atrial fibrillation (I48.91, I47.1). Given the intermittent nature of these symptoms and the need for continuous rhythm correlation over an extended period, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered to capture arrhythmic events and guide further management.
